neighbours.label: the verb or preposition right after 'only' in a usage restriction ('is only used for', 'only called when'), versus the same clause without 'only'
fire:
# this flag is only used by the test suite
DEBUG = False
The emergency exit is only opened during fire drills.
This function is only called after the config has loaded.
The back gate is only used when the main road floods.
Note: the cache is only read at startup.
The old ballroom is only used for weddings now.
This hook is only called if the user is logged in.
The guest room is only heated in the winter months.
quiet:
# this flag is set by the test suite
DEBUG = False
The emergency exit is opened during fire drills.
This function is called after the config has loaded.
The back gate is closed when the main road floods.
Note: the cache is read at startup.
The old ballroom was restored for weddings now.
This hook is registered once the user is logged in.
Only two of the rooms are heated in the winter months.

predictions: probably holds; risk that some unrestricted 'used when' quiet items reach 0.3 (probe 0.275)
